tool_input.description: Scratch-test multi-level nested class resolution and abbreviation edge cases

result:
Good, scratch files are cleaned up and not a git repo (expected). The only file created/modified is the test class itself.

I wrote `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ClassUtilsAgentTest.java` with 33 test methods covering `ClassUtils`'s public API: name/canonical-name helpers, `getClass` (including nested-class dot syntax, array dimension limit of 255, and the 65,535 class-name-length limit), `getAbbreviatedName` boundary cases, `isAssignable` (primitive widening, autoboxing, arrays), `hierarchy`, `getPublicMethod`, primitive/wrapper conversions, `toClass`, `comparator`, and the short-class-name logic for inner, anonymous, and local classes.

All 33 tests pass against the current implementation — I did not find a bug in `ClassUtils` that contradicts its documented behavior. No bugs to report.
